title: 15m inverse FVG: buy the first close back above a bearish displacement gap, trapped-seller reversal, 12h cap
ex_ante_rule:
Chart 15m, UTC, closed bars only; a signal at the close of bar t fills at the open of bar t+1. No higher-timeframe filter. Warm-up: 30 bars (longest lookback is the swing-low window k-2..t, at most 27 bars; no recursive indicators).
GAP DETECTION at the close of bar k: a bearish FVG exists if high(k) < low(k-2). Gap top GT = low(k-2), gap bottom GB = high(k). The gap is valid only if (GT-GB)/GB >= 0.004 AND the middle bar k-1 is a down displacement: close(k-1) < open(k-1) AND open(k-1)/close(k-1) - 1 >= 0.01. Only the most recent valid bearish gap is tracked: a new valid gap replaces any older tracked gap, which is dropped.
INVERSION SIGNAL: for bars t = k+1 .. k+24 (inclusive, 6 hours), the signal is the close of the FIRST bar t with close(t) > GT AND close(t) > open(t). A wick above GT without such a close does not count. If no such bar occurs by the close of bar k+24, the gap is dropped. The gap is consumed at its first qualifying bar t whether or not a trade is opened (one entry per gap).
RISK FILTER: swing low SL = lowest low of bars k-2 .. t inclusive. R = close(t) - SL. Trade only if 0.008 <= R/close(t) <= 0.03; otherwise skip and drop the gap.
ENTRY: buy at open(t+1) only if flat on that pair, fewer than 3 entries already opened on that pair in the current UTC day (counted by entry fill time), and open(t+1) > SL (else skip).
STOP: fixed price SL, frozen at entry; equivalently a fixed stop of (entry_price - SL)/entry_price below the entry price, set once per trade (custom_stoploss returning that frozen distance), touched intrabar. Native stoploss backstop -0.035.
TAKE PROFIT: limit sell at TP = close(t) + 1.5*R, touched intrabar (fill at TP, or at the bar open if the bar opens above TP).
If stop and TP are both touched in the same bar, assume the stop.
TIME EXIT: if still open, sell at the open of the bar 48 bars (12 hours) after the entry bar. No other exits, no trailing stop, no cooldown beyond the rules above.
rationale: A bearish fair value gap after a 15m bar that falls at least 1% open-to-close marks one-sided, aggressive selling (stop runs, forced liquidations, momentum sellers chasing). When, within six hours, a bullish 15m bar closes above the entire gap, every seller who sold inside the imbalance is underwater and the supply that created it has been absorbed. Those sellers' buy-stops sit above the gap; their covering, plus the stops of breakdown shorts on venues where they exist and the reversal buyers, push price further: the trapped-trader logic of Turtle Soup, anchored to the imbalance instead of a prior low. Counterparties: late momentum sellers and liquidated longs who sold the drop. The required displacement bar and 0.4% gap are themselves a volatility-expansion condition implied by the mechanism (rule meaning kept: no extra filter added). Cost: the stop is 0.8-3% away, so the target is 1.2-4.5% gross and an average trade's absolute gross move should be well above 1%, against a 0.30% base / 0.45% conservative round trip (cost <= 0.375R at the narrowest risk, ~0.15R typical); the break-even win rate at base cost is roughly 42-48%. Expected 60-200 trades per year per pair (alts more, BTC fewer), all flat within 12 hours. In a falling market, displacement gaps are more frequent but inversions rarer and more often fail; the 1.5R target and the full-gap close requirement are the protection, not a regime filter. Timeframe 15m is kept as the idea specifies (all bar counts are 15m bars). No published backtest for this exact rule was found; sources give the gap definition and the inversion concept only.
novelty_vs_tried: No FVG/imbalance family exists in the lab. HourlyFailedBreakdownReclaim (capped) and SessionRangeJudasSweep buy a reclaim of a prior swing low or session range; VolumeSpikeCrashRebound buys after a volume crash. Here the trigger level is the top of a three-bar price gap left by a measured >=1% down displacement bar, and the entry needs a bullish close through the WHOLE gap within 24 bars, with a structural stop at the swing low of the pattern and a 1.5R target. The gap level is set by the selling bar's own structure, not by a session clock, a lookback extreme, or a volume threshold.
data_visible_at_proposal: No price data inspected; only the H-110 context file (exploration-only learnings digest for the nine enabled pairs) and the two web sources.
